name: Taktikal Brigade
legend: The Orks who belong to the Blood Axe clan seek to apply their own brand of taktiks to their endless wars. The most cunning of Blood Axe leaders have adapted the strategies of other species into a unique brand of clandestine warfare that, whilst simplistic, is brutally effective.

rules.name: Lissen ’Ere
rules.legend: Blood Axe leaders bellow actual orders to the ladz under their command.
rules.description_html:
Once per battle round, in your Command phase or after being set up on the battlefield in your Movement phase, each Boss Snikrot, Mek and Warboss model in your army can issue Taktiks abilities.

To do so, select one of the Taktiks abilities below and select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of that model to issue them to. That model must take a Leadership test: if failed, the selected unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Until the start of your next Command phase, the selected unit is affected by the selected Taktik. A unit cannot have Taktiks issued to it in this way more than once per battle round.

Taktiks abilities cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit affected by Taktiks becomes Battle-shocked, all Taktiks cease to affect that unit while it is Battle-shocked.

Get Stuck In: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for this unit.

Get On Wiv It: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

Sneaky Stalkin’: Infantry and Mounted models (excluding Meganobz) in this unit have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets this unit, those models have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Shoota Drills: Each time an INFANTRY or MOUNTED model in this unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

KEYWORDS
Stormboyz units from your army gain the Battleline keyword.

stratagems.name: KRUNCHIN’ DESCENT
stratagems.legend: With their rocket packs at full throttle, Stormboyz plummet to smash into their foes with bone-crushing force.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a STORMBOYZ unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That Stormboyz unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.description_text:

TARGET: That Stormboyz unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: FIGHT PROPPA
stratagems.legend: Some deviant Blood Axes go so far as to practise hand-to-hand combat, tailoring fighting styles to specific types of enemies.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Orks Infantry or Orks Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.description_text:

EFFECT: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.name: DED SNEAKY
stratagems.legend: Utilising camouflage, cover or misdirection, these Orks slip away to prepare their next ambush, leaving their foes staring at thin air.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One Kommandos or Stormboyz unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.description_text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One Kommandos or Stormboyz unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: ON TO DA NEXT
stratagems.legend: Seeing little value in pursuing fleeing foes, Blood Axe mobs turn their attention towards the next fight or press towards whatever cache of shiny gubbinz the boss desires.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.description_text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: TAKTIKAL RETREAT
stratagems.legend: Blood Axes feel no shame in retreating from a fight, particularly if the boss wants someone else duffed up.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.description_text:

stratagems.name: DAT’S OURS
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of the Blood Axe Clan, can resist their destructive urges long enough to prioritise the seizing of objectives.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

enhancements.name: Skwad Leader
enhancements.legend: An exemplar of the Blood Axes’ devious arts, this Warboss leads mobs of cunning Kommandos to battle.
enhancements.description_html: Warboss Infantry model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Kommandos unit. While leading a Kommandos unit, it has the Infiltrators and Stealth abilities.

enhancements.name: Mek Kaptin
enhancements.legend: Whilst Flash Gitz hate discipline of any sort, particularly militant Meks can keep them in line with a combination of brutal discipline and the promise of shiny gubbinz.
enhancements.description_html: Big Mek, Big Mek in Mega Armour or Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Flash Gitz unit. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Mork’s Kunnin’
enhancements.legend: Possessed of an exceptionally keen mind – for an Ork at least – this boss matches wits with his opponents, holding his ladz back until an opportune moment arrives.
enhancements.description_html: ORKS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ORKS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Gob Boomer
enhancements.legend: Cobbled together from the remains of a humie vox-caster, this device amplifies this Ork’s already booming voice, carrying their bellowed orders further
enhancements.description_html: Warboss or Mek model only. Each time the bearer issues Taktiks, it can do so to a friendly Orks Infantry or Orks Mounted unit within 18", instead of 6".
